feedback: The confession follows the document contradiction available before voting and confirms the inferred transfer into the unattended private glass. Justin's statement that he took poison during the preview supplies precise timing, but that timing is not needed to identify his false neutralization account and his glass opportunity. His anxiety about becoming the discredited storyteller is already established through the omitted settlement and threatened rebuttal, so the emotional consequence feels earned. Chip and Barb's endings acknowledge real culpability without turning their misconduct into murder. The finale is concise and satisfying, although Justin's confession mostly restates the deduction rather than adding a dramatic confrontation. It closes the folder and reputation themes effectively.
